##### Project General Facts

SKY LEVEL 1 is a landmark residential development rising in District 11 of Jumeirah Village Circle, designed as a modern architectural statement inspired by the beauty of the cosmos. The tower features a striking structure composed of 2 basement levels, ground floor, 5 podium levels, office floors, and 35 residential floors, creating a dynamic mixed-use environment. Offering thoughtfully designed one-bedroom apartments, the project combines contemporary elegance with innovative design, positioning itself as a new benchmark for elevated urban living with a total of 420 units.

The development offers an exceptional range of amenities designed to enhance everyday living. Residents can enjoy a sky infinity pool, sky observation deck with digital telescopes, and a sky deck with sun loungers, creating a unique leisure experience above the city. Additional facilities include a fully equipped gym, AI-powered fitness studio, outdoor CrossFit area, swimming pools, BBQ areas, outdoor lounges, and dedicated kids’ play areas including a creative digital coloring wall. The project also features retail spaces, office terraces, prayer rooms, and landscaped relaxation zones, ensuring a balanced lifestyle for residents of all ages.

The apartments are designed with a focus on modern comfort and smart living, featuring high-quality finishes and contemporary interiors. Kitchens are stylishly designed and complemented by modern fittings, while living spaces are bright and functional. The project incorporates smart home features such as a smart lock access system with fingerprint, mobile, and PIN entry, enhancing convenience and security. Overall, SKY LEVEL 1 delivers a refined residential experience with a strong emphasis on technology, design, and quality finishing.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a well-established community that strategicallly nestles between Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, offering a lifestyle built on balance - urban energy with a neighborhood feel. The area features a range of amenities, including schools, parks, retail, and dining, all within easy reach, making it an ideal location for those seeking a balanced and fulfilling lifestyle. The community's strong investment fundamentals and family-oriented environment make it an attractive destination for residents and investors alike.

The location is distinguished by its strong investment fundamentals and family-oriented environment. JVC continues to evolve as one of Dubai's most sought-after residential destinations, with new developments, infrastructure growth, and rising end-user demand. Landscaped parks, schools, nurseries, and everyday conveniences are within walking distance, making it an ideal community for modern family living.

For those seeking a refined and connected lifestyle, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched experience, with its unique combination of community feel, urban convenience, and prime Dubai address. The area's strong sense of community, coupled with its vibrant amenities and strategic location, make it a highly desirable destination for families, professionals, and investors. The location's effortless connectivity and refined atmosphere make it an ideal place to live, invest, and grow.
